name: GlowFormat
description: Represents the glow formatting for a shape or range of shapes.

properties.name: Radius
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the length of the radius for a glow effect. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color for a glow effect. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified GlowFormat object.
